title: lint: split rule-explanations.ts into one file per rule with a generated index, move-only (hot-file card E)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card E (lane: server per the report; triage confirms)

`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` is one large file every new lint rule edits. Split it into one file per rule with a generated index.

- Move-only; the generated index is checked by a gate that already exists or by the build (no new gate unless named).
- Done when: two PRs that each add a rule do not conflict on the explanations, and every rule's explanation text is byte-identical before/after.
- Large-PR approval as card D.
